content.title: How to watch 'Euphoria' Season 3: Where to stream tonight for free, premiere date and more
content.text: The third and final season of Euphoria is officially here, and we're already off to a shocking start in the first episode, which aired on HBO on Sunday, April 12. We're seeing the return of the characters played by Zendaya, Jacob Elordi, Sydney Sweeney, and Alexa Demie, as well as the late Eric Dane, who returns as Cal Jacobs. There's also a five-year time jump this season, meaning the main characters are about 22–24 years old, to put things in perspective.Since Season 1 aired all the way back in 2019, we wanted to see just how much the cast and characters have changed since we first met them. So, here's a comparison of what every main Euphoria character looked like in the first season they appeared in versus Season 3:1. First, here's Zendaya as Rue Bennett in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBOFor context, Rue is 17 years old in Season 1 and starts the show as a high school junior. In the third season, she becomes a drug mule for Laurie (whom Rue now owes $100,000 for the suitcase of drugs she received from Laurie and lost in Season 2).This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO, HBO2. Here's Jacob Elordi as Nate Jacobs in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBONate is an 18-year-old senior at East Highland High School in Season 1. In the third season, Nate takes over his dad's real estate development business. He and Cassie are also engaged and living together.This is him in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO3. Here's Hunter Schafer as Jules Vaughn in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBOIn Season 1, Jules is 17 years old and a high school junior who recently moved to East Highland. In the third season, Jules is attending an arts school and has become a "sugar baby," according to Lexi in Episode 1.This is her in Season 3: Eddy Chen/HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO4. Here's Sydney Sweeney as Cassie Howard in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBOIn Season 1, Cassie is a 17-year-old senior at East Highland High. In Season 3, she and Nate are engaged and living together as she tries to become famous on TikTok and Instagram. But she plans to switch to ******** to make enough money to afford the $50,000 worth of flowers she wants for their wedding.This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO, HBO5. Here's Alexa Demie as Maddy Perez in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBOMaddy is 17 years old in Season 1 and also a high school junior. In the third season, she is an assistant talent manager for influencers and actors in Hollywood. Based on the released trailers for the season, it seems that Maddy helps Cassie manage her ******** account later on in the season.This is her in Season 3: Eddy Chen/HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO6. Here's Eric Dane as Cal Jacobs in Season 1: Eddy Chen/HBOIn Season 1, Cal is leading a double life, appearing to be a successful businessman while having anonymous ****** encounters with Jules and young men at motels. In the third season, he is dealing with the aftermath of his breakdown and arrest at the end of Season 2. He seems to reconnect with characters such as Jules and Nate later in the season.This is him in Season 3: Eddy Chen/HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO7. Here's Maude Apatow as Lexi Howard in Season 1: HBOIn Season 1, Lexi is a 16-year-old junior at East Highland High. In the third season, she is a writer's assistant in Hollywood on the nighttime soap opera LA Nights for "legendary showrunner" Patty Lance (played by Sharon Stone).This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: HBO8. Here's Colman Domingo as Ali in Season 1: HBOIn Season 1, Ali is a recovering addict and serves as a mentor and sober guide to Rue at Narcotics Anonymous meetings. He continues in this role in the third season, as he and Rue meet at a diner to discuss her 12-step program and Rue's faith in God.This is him in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: HBO9. Here's Chloe Cherry as Faye in Season 2: Eddy Chen/HBOIn Season 2, Faye is staying with Fez and Ashtray after her boyfriend, Custer, gets into legal trouble. In the third season, she works as a drug mule with Rue to pay off Rue's debt to Laurie, and they smuggle fentanyl balloons across the US-Mexico border by swallowing them.This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: Eddy Chen/HBO, HBO10. Here's Nika King as Leslie Bennett in Season 1: HBOIn Season 1, Leslie is dealing with the trauma of losing her husband while battling to keep Rue clean. While she is set to play a small role in the third season, when she appears has not yet been confirmed.This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: HBO11. And finally, here's Martha Kelly as Laurie in Season 2: HBOIn Season 2, Laurie is introduced as Fezco's drug supplier. Rue asks Laurie to become a runner for her, and Laurie fronts her a suitcase of drugs that Rue's mom then disposes of, leaving Rue owing Laurie thousands of dollars. In the third season, Laurie tracks Rue down and forces her to become a drug mule to settle the debt for Rue's failure to pay her back.This is her in Season 3: HBOAnd here they are side by side: HBOAre there any character transformations from Season 1 to Season 3 of Euphoria that surprised you?
